text:
maya: Quick async standup — gateway / routing / auth / rate-limits.

maya: Done: landed header-based routing predicate in staging (X-Client-Type). Added unit + integration tests.
maya: Blocker: we're seeing unexpected 429 spikes from a subset of legacy clients when gateway policy ordering changed. Looks like the legacy-exempt rule is being evaluated after the global rate limiter.
maya: Today: planning a quick mitigation (reorder policy + canary rollback) and a PR with a fix, will ping for reviews. @sam @jon 

sam: On it. I'll review the PR once it's up. Quick note: policy ordering is deterministic but the rollout tooling applies canary rules in a separate layer which might reorder at runtime.
sam: Saw two e2e flakes locally: ``ERROR: rate_limit exceeded for key user:123`` — could repro with curl load script.

jon: I dug into the auth cache TTLs — we had a recent tweak to token cache TTL from 30s -> 5s to reduce stale auth, that increases requests hitting the auth service and causing more upstream 429s. I reverted the TTL in my local branch to 30s and retested; seemed to smooth the burst.

lena: FYI I rolled back the canary on staging at 08:14 — logs show burst at 08:09. I attached the small log excerpt below.
lena: ```
[08:09:12] gateway: request from client legacy-42 -> matched route /v1/legacy
[08:09:12] policy:evaluate order=[global-rate, legacy-exempt, auth] -> global-rate applied -> 429
```

maya: Thanks — that log aligns with my hypothesis. Plan: 1) roll back canary on prod (already scheduled), 2) reorder policy so legacy-exempt runs before global rate, 3) add a regression test to prevent policy reorder regressions. I'll open the PR for (2) in ~15m and tag @sam @jon for quick review.

sam: Ping me when it's up. If we change ordering, add a changelog entry in the gateway policy docs and a small automation test that synthesizes multiple client types.

jon: Also, I'll push a config tweak to auth caching as a short-term mitigation — will notify ops.

infra-bot: deploybot: started rollback job gw-canary-2026-11 at 1893456800 (initiated by lena). Status: in_progress. :gear:

maya: Blocker update: none remaining after rollback scheduled, still want review on the PR quickly to unstick prod. If review delayed, I'll revert the policy change as a hotfix.

sam: Acknowledged. ETA for review: 20–30m.

lena: Leaving this for incident follow-up if anything else pops up. I'll monitor alerts for the next hour. :eyes:

maya: Thanks team. Short follow-ups later if needed.
